# Research visits

Short research visits to the Translational Sensory & Circadian Neuroscience Unit (MPS/TUM/TUMCREATE) may be possible when they are mutually beneficial. We consider whether the proposed work fits the unit's research, can be carried out in the available time, and has appropriate support.

## Funding a visit

We encourage prospective visitors to apply for external funding, for example through [DAAD](funding.qmd#daad). [Erasmus+](funding.qmd#erasmus) may also support eligible student or doctoral placements through the visitor's home institution. Eligibility, supported duration and deadlines depend on the scheme.

See [External funding](funding.qmd) for these and other routes. Contact us before submitting a funding application that names the unit as a host, so that we can agree on the work and hosting arrangements.

## Proposing a visit

Outline the research question, what you hope to achieve together, your relevant experience and the proposed dates and duration. Include any funding you hold or plan to apply for.

[How to enquire about a research visit](apply.qmd#fellowships-and-research-visits)
